text:
Jordan: Quick weekly pulse for Kestrel (acct KST-42). TL;DR: tokens down WoW -12%, QoQ +9; p95 latency +45ms WoW (now ~520ms). Spend down WoW -6% but cost/token up ~18% — digging into causes.

Priya: Thanks — can you drop the topline numbers?

Jordan: ```
Avg tokens/day: 1.24M  (-12% WoW, +9% QoQ)
Peak RPS: 85 -> 78 (-8% WoW)
Throughput (tokens/s): 1,400 -> 1,230 (-12% WoW)
Sequence length (median -> 90th): 256 -> 980 (recent ingestion change)
P50 latency: 120ms (+10ms WoW)
P95 latency: 520ms (+45ms WoW)
Error rate (4xx/5xx): 0.6% -> 1.2% (spike Tue 03:10 UTC)
Weekly spend: $2,900 (-6% WoW, +3% QoQ)
Cost / 1k tokens: $2.34 (+18% WoW)
```

Akira: I skimmed the logs — lots of retries and a burst of long seq requests around Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC. Likely their new ingestion pipeline sent bigger batched prompts.

Evan: I'll correlate with infra autoscale events. Opening ticket INC-3217 to trace GPU pod churn + cold starts. Assigning to eng-runtime.

Priya: Heads-up — Kestrel asked for an enablement session last week about batching best practices. Their token profile changed (seq len up) so cost/per-call jumped. Recommend: short-term quantization + prefix caching; medium-term prompt refactor.

Jordan: Action items:
- Evan: follow up on INC-3217, attach autoscaler logs (due EOD Thu).
- Akira: draft a 1-pager playbook (batching + quantization + cache hints) for the enablement call (due Fri).
- Priya: book 30m enablement with Kestrel for next Tue; capture feedback for renewal risk doc.
- BillingBot: confirm renewal date and current commit utilization.

BillingBot: Next renewal: 28 days. Current committed utilization: 68%. No immediate overage alerts.

Priya: Noting renewal is still green, but call out latency hit + higher cost per token in renewal prep. Will add a short note to the renewal risks doc and surface during the call.

Jordan: Also recommend we offer a tailored quantization config and a short eval run (2 days) to show cost delta — low-friction upsell.

Akira: I'll include example config snippets, e.g.:
```json
{"quantize": "int8", "batch_size": 8, "KV_cache": true}
```

Evan: INC-3217 created: https://redwood.atlassian/INC-3217 — added initial logs and spike timeline.

Jordan: Great. Thanks all :thumbsup: Will close the loop after the enablement and infra ticket updates.

Priya: Adding meeting invite now :calendar:
